record.title: LPG Cabinet Heaters for Indoor Domestic Use - Safety Requirements
record.description:
Specifies safety, combustion, gas-tightness, burner, ignition, flame-failure, and marking requirements for cabinet-type LPG room heaters intended for indoor domestic use.

Applies to cabinet heaters using LPG supplied from portable cylinders under the defined appliance configuration; excludes industrial heaters and permanently installed central heating equipment.

Key requirements: Gas-carrying components shall maintain gas-tightness over the declared operating range.; Burner combustion shall remain within the defined safety limits.; Flame-failure protection shall safely interrupt gas flow under the specified failure condition.

Testing: Gas-tightness and leak verification.; Flame-failure device response test.
record.certification_applicability: Certification applicable where a product-specific control order requires conformity to this standard; operation without the applicable conformity route is outside this demo dataset assumptions.
